findings.title: Thick Blood and Staunch overwrite rather than compose, with lifecycle-dependent results
findings.reproduction_evidence: Both allowed traits write the same UT_bleedDecayMult and bandagedOnly keys. The last listener wins; Thick Blood uses OnNewGame while Staunch uses OnCreatePlayer, so combined state cannot be stable or equal to the claimed 4.5x stack.
findings.recommended_correction: Represent per-trait decay contributions and compose them deterministically on new game/load; define whether combination is multiplicative and test exact hook output.
findings.smallest_regression_test: With both traits, assert exact bandaged/unbandaged decay after new-game and after simulated save-load; values must be identical across lifecycle.
findings.resolution_evidence: Thick Blood and Staunch now own independent multiplicative decay factors. Focused tests prove 4.5x bandaged, 1.5x unbandaged, and Staunch removal without Thick Blood loss.
findings.remaining_runtime_proof: Current-build Kahlua, live wounds, new game, save load, death, rendered English, balance, and profiler observation remain unrun.
